title: Import Supporting Read Permission Consistency

items.action: enter the fair-scoped import creation flow
hydrate optional fair display details when authorized
hydrate optional fair participant count when authorized

migration.reason: Existing Core permission codes are reused.

backend.reason: Backend authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; the UI only avoids supporting read calls when the corresponding effective permission is absent.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend query or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: No business mutation or audit behavior changes.

route_guard.reason: Accepted route permission requirements are unchanged; supporting reads are conditional inside the wizard.

notes: The fair-scoped creation route intentionally remains governed by fair_crm.imports.create only. Fair display hydration is attempted only with fair_crm.fairs.read, participant-count hydration only with fair_crm.participations.read, and participant-count failure cannot erase an already authorized fair result. A preselected fair remains fixed even when its display details are not readable.
